violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE AT START WORK SHIFT DON GLOVES TO BEGIN FOOD PREPARATION WITHOUT WASHING HANDS.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO REMOVE GLOVES AND WASH HANDS BEFORE DONNING CLEAN GLOVES. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEE TRAINING AND CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO WASH HANDS AT HANDWASH SINK ONLY. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEES TRAINING AND COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at handwashing sink: BETWEEN PREP LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO PROVIDE HAND SOAP DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE ALL HANDWASH SINKS ARE PROPERLY SUPPLIED.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW CHICKEN STORED ABOVE BEVERAGES IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, 4 Hour Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed FOOD CONTAINERS USED TO REHEAT PORTIONED FOODS FOR IMMEDIATE SERVICE located at the 2 DOOR PREP TOPS that are not being cleaned at least every 4 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils must be cleaned and sanitized at least every 4 hours to prevent contamination by bacterial growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REMOVE CONTAINERS FOR CLEANING AND SANITIZING. PLEASE ENSURE CONTAINERS USED TO REHEAT FOODS ARE CLEANED AND SANITIZED NO LESS THAN EVERY 4 HOURS. EGGHOLIC (Inspection Date: 10/28/2026) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: SHREDDED CHICKEN AT 47F, YOGURT SAUCE AT 44F MANGO LASSI AT 44F AND YOGURT CHASS AT 43F IN ARCTIC AIR 2 DOOR PREP TOP (LEFT); RICE AT 48-53F ON COUNTER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD CHICKEN AND RICE. OTHER FOODS WERE TRANSFERRED TO WALK IN REFRIGERATOR FOR RAPID COOLING TO 41F.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): RICE ON COUNTER WITHOUT WRITTEN PROCEDURES.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS WILL FORWARD TPHC DOCUMENTATION TO PIC. PLEASE ENSURE TPHC PROCEDURES ARE PROPERLY MAINTAINED. COMPLIANCE WILL BE VERIFIED BY NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor: FOODS STORED DIRECTLY ON FLOOR IN DRY STORAGE ROOM.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE DUNNAGE RACKS OR APPROVED SHELVING FOR STORAGE OF FOODS AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: UTENSILS STORED IN WATER AT 74F NEAR ARCTIC AIR 2 DOOR PREP TOP (LEFT).
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REMOVED UTENSILS FOR CLEANING AND SANITIZING.
